newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SEA says to sell unit for HK$858 mln.
newsitem.headline: SEA says to sell unit for HK$858 mln.

text.p: SEA Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it has agreed to sell its indirectly wholly-owned Elson Holdings Ltd to third party Right Success Ltd for HK$858 million.
The price includes a HK$297 million loan Elson owes to an SEA subsidiary, the company said.
Elson indirectly owns the 22-storey China Underwriters Centre and 17 parking spaces at Belgian Bank Tower, both in the Wanchai district of Hong Kong island, SEA said in a statement.
The disposal will give the SEA group an estimated exceptional gain after expenses and minority interests of about HK$694.48 million, the statement said. It gave no further details.
The company said the proceeds would increase its investment capacity for future acquisitions, although no specific investment had been identified.
The deal is expected to be completed on March 27, it said.
SEA shares were up HK$0.05 at HK$5.25 at midday.
